verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI lists "exports" among its documented functions, so there is some first-party export capability for scraped data. Nothing describes the export formats, and nothing covers exporting job or schedule configurations for migration. missing for 10: documented portable export formats for scraped data, export of job/schedule configurations, any migration or anti-lock-in documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
